C1095.title: Shandong Province Exposes Typical Cases of False and Illegal Advertising
C1095.summary: The Shandong Administration for Market Regulation publicly exposed a batch of typical false and illegal advertising cases, including a Yantai medical aesthetics hospital that published advertisements inconsistent with its review and approval documents and made false descriptions, deceiving and misleading consumers, constituting false advertising.

references.title: Shandong Administration for Market Regulation Releases Typical Internet Illegal Advertising Cases
